generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Sample from parent primary-key pool; include NULL rows (nullable FK) and rows referencing parent keys that have no child (parent rows without children).
generic_sampling_rules.int_quantity: Integer > 0; sample within observed range with boundary values at listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.real_positive: Real > 0; sample within observed range with boundary values at listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Short text drawn from a small pool of realistic values; allow near-variants (case changes) and duplicates for DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.text_nullable: Nullable text; include NULL rows at 5-30% share and non-NULL rows.
generic_sampling_rules.year_int: Integer year in [1900, 2030]; allow duplicates for DISTINCT columns.
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: 0.3 of text values are fresh near-variants; 0.7 drawn from pool.

semantic_rules_and_formulas.formula: Type IN ('Mass suicide murder', 'Mass suicide', 'Mass human sacrifice')

supporting_evidence.High_Estimate >= Low_Estimate: Rows 1-8 of film_market_estimation all satisfy High_Estimate >= Low_Estimate (e.g. 80400>=80000, 8000>=8000, 960>=3000? no — row 3 has Low=3000, High=960, contradicts; formula dropped).
supporting_evidence.Gross_in_dollar >= 0: All 8 shown film rows have positive gross.
supporting_evidence.Number_cities > 0: All 6 shown market rows have positive city counts.
supporting_evidence.Type enum: Three distinct values observed: 'Mass suicide murder', 'Mass suicide', 'Mass human sacrifice'.

generation_specification.uncertainty: High_Estimate >= Low_Estimate is contradicted by row 3 (Low=3000, High=960) and was dropped. Year range 1900-2030 is a soft assumption; observed years include 1487 which is outside, so the range rule is uncertain. Type enum is based on only 3 observed values.

issues.evidence: The specification's supporting_evidence itself notes that 'High_Estimate >= Low_Estimate' is contradicted by row 3 (Low=3000, High=960) and was dropped, yet the semantic_rules_and_formulas list still contains the formula 'High_Estimate >= Low_Estimate'. The program (instance.py _apply_high_low) enforces it by construction, so the spec text and the program disagree about whether the rule is active.
issues.requested_revision: Remove the 'High_Estimate >= Low_Estimate' formula from semantic_rules_and_formulas (or move it to an explicitly-uncertain section) so the specification is internally consistent with its own supporting_evidence and with the program's behavior.

issues.evidence: The 'Year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2030' rule is flagged as uncertain in the spec ('observed years include 1487 which is outside'), but the program clamps Year to [1900,2030] in _apply_year_range. This silently rewrites observed-domain values and could suppress legitimate boundary variation around 1487.
issues.requested_revision: Either drop the Year range rule (treat as uncertain) or document it as a hard constraint; do not leave it as a soft assumption that the program nevertheless enforces unconditionally.

issues.evidence: Execution feedback shows nullable columns film.Director, film.Gross_in_dollar, film.Title, film_market_estimation.High_Estimate/Low_Estimate/Type/Year, market.Country, market.Number_cities all report 'NULL 0 / n'. Per the interface NULL rule these are noted, not blocking, but the spec's null_targets only lists film.Studio and the two FKs, so the zero-NULL columns are consistent with the spec. No action strictly required, but the engineer should confirm the compact DB's NULL share for these columns is genuinely 0 (otherwise _null_share_for would have planted NULLs).
issues.requested_revision: No blocking change; optionally verify compact-DB NULL shares for the zero-NULL columns to confirm the sampler's behavior matches the interface rule.

issues.evidence: construction_pairs: eligible 61, separated 23. Many boundary/duplicate/group-size patterns (e.g. market.Country duplicate_share 20-50%, film.Studio group_sizes 1/2/>=3, film.Gross_in_dollar aggregate_boundary at 4.5M and -3966777) are not demonstrably separated. The spec's aggregate_boundary values include negative literals (-3966778..-3966776) while the program applies _apply_nonneg to Gross_in_dollar, so the negative boundary can never be hit; the positive 4.5M boundary is only reachable if the sampler's range covers it.
issues.requested_revision: Reconcile the aggregate_boundary negative literals with the 'Gross_in_dollar >= 0' formula: either drop the negative boundary values from the spec or relax the nonneg rule. Also ensure NumberSampler bounds for Gross_in_dollar actually span 4,499,999/4,500,000/4,500,001 so the aggregate boundary is reachable.

issues.evidence: The spec's comparison_boundary for market.Number_cities targets 299/300/301/302 and film_market_estimation.Low_Estimate targets 9999/10000/10001, but the program's NumberSampler only adds boundary literals to the element pool; with p=0.2/0.0 and fresh_share behavior, boundary values may rarely be drawn. Execution shows only 23/61 pairs separated, consistent with weak boundary coverage.
issues.requested_revision: Increase the probability of drawing boundary literals (e.g. bias the element pool toward boundary values, or force at least one boundary draw per instance) so comparison_boundary patterns are reliably exercised.

issues.evidence: The spec's duplicates_for_distinct targets (20-50% duplicate share) for market.Country, film.Studio, film.Director, film_market_estimation.Type/Year are not enforced by construction: StringSampler draws from a pool with fresh_share=0.3 and random mutations, so duplicate share is uncontrolled. film_market_estimation.Type uses EnumSampler over 3 values, which yields ~33% duplicates (within range) but is not explicitly targeted.
issues.requested_revision: Add explicit duplicate-share control for the listed DISTINCT columns (e.g. sample a target duplicate fraction per instance and draw accordingly) so the 20-50% target is met by construction rather than by chance.

issues.evidence: The spec's group_sizes target for film.Studio ('1, 2 and >= 3') is not implemented: no code path in instance.py or values.py enforces group-size distribution for Studio. The aggregate_boundary for film.Gross_in_dollar (HAVING AVG >= 4500000) is likewise not constructed; _apply_nonneg only clamps to >=0.
issues.requested_revision: Implement group-size and aggregate-boundary construction for film.Studio/Gross_in_dollar (e.g. partition Studio values into groups of size 1, 2, and >=3, and ensure at least one group's AVG crosses 4,500,000).

issues.evidence: The spec's unmatched_join_rows targets require parent_rows_without_children and child_rows_with_null_fk for film/film_market_estimation and market/film_market_estimation. The program plants NULL FKs (43/180 and 26/180 observed) but does not guarantee parent rows without children: _fresh_pk_values assigns sequential PKs and fill_foreign_keys_consistently draws from the full parent pool, so every parent may get a child. No code ensures some parent PKs are excluded from the child FK pool.
issues.requested_revision: Reserve a subset of parent PKs that are never drawn into the child FK column (parent_rows_without_children), in addition to the planted NULL FKs, to satisfy the unmatched_join_rows target.

issues.evidence: The spec's comparison_boundary for film_market_estimation.Film_ID / film.Film_ID ('equal_and_one_step_from') is not implemented: no code ensures child FK values equal parent PK or differ by one step. fill_foreign_keys_consistently draws uniformly from the parent pool, so equal/one-step adjacency is incidental.
issues.requested_revision: Add construction ensuring some child FK values equal a parent PK and some differ by exactly one step, per the equal_and_one_step_from target.

issues.evidence: The spec's rows_with_different_values for market.Number_cities (SUM/COUNT vs AVG) and film_market_estimation.High_Estimate (MAX scalar) are not constructed; the program has no code path targeting these. Execution shows 23/61 pairs separated, and these patterns are among the unseparated ones.
issues.requested_revision: Add construction for rows_with_different_values patterns (e.g. ensure at least two groups with differing Number_cities values, and at least two distinct High_Estimate values with a clear MAX).

unresolved_checks: Whether the compact DB's NULL share for the zero-NULL nullable columns is genuinely 0 (would explain the 'NULL 0 / n' lines without violating the interface rule).
Whether the 4,500,000 aggregate boundary is reachable given the NumberSampler range for Gross_in_dollar (scale=10, unsigned=False, bounds from spec).
Whether the 23/61 separated construction pairs reflect genuine generation gaps or merely sampling variance across 20 instances; a larger run would clarify.
Whether the 'Year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2030' rule should be treated as hard or soft given the observed 1487 value.
